Game Overview

Tap Ninja is a action title where slip into ninja mode and tap your way to victory in Tap Ninja. Capture falling items swiftly to score big while artfully dodging explosive dynamite. This enthralling game demands precision and razor-sharp reflexes, ensuring countless hours of addictive tapping fun. Aim high, challenge yourself, and perfect your ninja prowess!
